input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is PAINTING STYLE ONLY, never copy its person, framing or pose. Keep the same face, headwear, clothes and single set of equipment. Lean adult man, copper skin, long black hair tied high behind swept pale lilac hood, ivory layered cloth with two narrow trailing lilac panels, silver wire charms and belt tools, slender bifurcated silver-bound staff. Sparse wind wisps and tiny branching lightning. REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally AWAY from viewer and toward image RIGHT, back surfaces visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, 16 separate complete poses of ONE SAME character. Read left to right, top to bottom. Row 1: four keys of a QUICK FLINCH AND RECOVERY: 1 ready upright pose; 2 sharp unmistakable recoil with shoulders and head pulled BACK by one head-width and torso bent back 25 degrees; 3 shoulders returning and braced bent legs; 4 upright recovered ready pose. These four poses MUST visibly differ, not four standing duplicates. Row 2: first four keys of a BIGGER STAGGER: 5 upright ready; 6 abrupt backward bend of upper body; 7 deepest backward bend, arms pulled close, balance visibly lost; 8 lower body catches the weight, bent knees or legs. Row 3: 9 pushing back upright, visibly struggling; 10 upright recovered. Then begin COLLAPSE: 11 ready upright; 12 legs buckle and body drops. Row 4: continue COLLAPSE: 13 body very low, leaning toward ground; 14 torso falls sideways nearly horizontal; 15 body settles FULLY LYING on its side, head and entire torso on ground; 16 body completely still FULLY LYING ON GROUND, legs extended or naturally folded, equipment resting beside it. The final TWO poses must be completely horizontal resting bodies, never crouching, kneeling, sitting or getting back up. Treat collapse as a harmless theatrical fall/rest pose, fully intact. No blood, gore, wounds or injury detail. No attacker, impact flash or effects. Each of the 16 equal cells contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 65% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only.

arguments.Prompt: Original painted game character 4x4 animation sprite sheet on solid uniform vivid MAGENTA background (#FF00FF). Exact character identity and equipment reference from Reference-1.png, painting style reference from Reference-2.png. Character: Lean adult man, copper skin, long black hair tied high behind swept pale lilac hood, ivory layered cloth robes with two narrow trailing lilac panels, silver wire charms and belt tools, slender bifurcated silver-bound staff. Sparse wind wisps and tiny branching lightning sparks. Camera and Perspective: REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view (elevated 55-degree orthographic angle, facing diagonally AWAY from viewer toward image right, back surfaces clearly visible). Consistent rear-right 3/4 perspective across all poses. Layout: Exactly 4 columns and 4 rows (16 distinct equal cells) on solid pure magenta background. Each cell contains ONE complete figure at identical scale, centered within 65% of the cell with wide empty magenta margins/gutters. No borders, no grid lines, no text, no ground plane, no background elements. Poses (4 rows x 4 columns, reading left-to-right, top-to-bottom): Row 1 (Quick flinch and recovery): Pose 1 ready upright combat pose; Pose 2 sharp flinch recoil with shoulders and head pulled back by one head-width and torso bent back 25 degrees; Pose 3 shoulders returning forward, legs bent and braced; Pose 4 upright recovered ready pose. Row 2 (Bigger stagger): Pose 5 upright ready stance; Pose 6 abrupt backward bend of upper body; Pose 7 deep backward stagger bend, arms pulled inward, balance visibly lost; Pose 8 lower body catching weight, deeply bent knees. Row 3 (Struggle recovery and begin collapse): Pose 9 pushing back upright, struggling; Pose 10 upright recovered stance; Pose 11 ready upright stance; Pose 12 legs buckle, knees giving way, body dropping downward. Row 4 (Collapse to lying down): Pose 13 body very low, sinking toward ground; Pose 14 torso falling sideways nearly horizontal; Pose 15 fully lying down on side on ground, head and torso on ground; Pose 16 completely still fully lying flat on ground, legs naturally resting, staff resting beside body. Style: Hand-painted digital dark fantasy illustration, sculpted painterly volume, sharp silver highlights, soft cool lighting from upper-left, smooth opaque paint, no heavy cartoon outlines, no 3D render, theatrical harmless knockdown, clean magenta gutters.
